docs.text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase if the product is unused. Shipping fees are non-refundable after delivery.
Standard shipping arrives in 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping arrives in 2 business days within the continental US.
To reset a password, open account settings, choose security, then send reset link. The link expires after 24 hours.
We retain account logs for 90 days. Billing records are kept for seven years to meet tax requirements.

The International Space Station is a large spacecraft in orbit around Earth. It serves as a home where crews of astronauts and cosmonauts live. The space station is also a unique science laboratory. It flies at an altitude of approximately 250 miles above Earth, completing 16 orbits per day at a speed of about 17,500 miles per hour.
